name: Komatsu Nanako
source:
She is the head of the "Love Club" that the main character belongs to, and her nickname is "Komatsuna," although she gets angry when you call her that. She is usually a cheerful, normal girl, with the exception of her cat-like appearance and slightly masculine tone of voice, but in reality she is rough and belligerent.

She has a complex about her short stature and breasts, so if she is played with or spoken to cheekily, she will resort to violence. She is not very fond of the stiff-necked Chidori.
